function.arguments: {"finding": "The contract specifies the population as 'all patients, deduplicated by patient_id', but the analysis removed rows with biomarker_baseline == -999, which altered the denominator. This violates the contract, which defines the population before any filtering. The population must include all deduplicated patients, regardless of baseline value. The sentinel values (-999) are not part of the population definition, so they must be excluded only if the estimand depends on valid baseline values. However, the response rate does not depend on baseline values — it is simply the proportion of responded == 1 among patients. Therefore, the exclusion of -999 rows is unjustified under the contract.", "implication": "The analysis must be re-run on the full deduplicated population (800 patients), without filtering out -999 baseline values, to respect the contract's population definition. The response rate is computed on all deduplicated patients, even those with -999 baseline, because the contract does not condition on valid baseline measurements."}
function.name: note_finding
